fieldValues.title: RFC-001: Views L2 — Rendering Hierarchy and Default Rendering Baseline
fieldValues.content: Defines the default (View-agnostic) rendering baseline, a normative heading hierarchy (`depthOffset`/`titleFieldId`), a portable `format` vocabulary with an L1/L2 precedence rule, and reserves `themeRef`/`themeVariants` plus the `ThemeReference`/`ThemeVariant` types on `DocumentView` for RFC-002. Full text: rfcs/rfc-001.md.

sourceRefs.note: RFC-001 from srs-spec.md - coarse source anchoring during migration
